name: hmi_create_screen_under_group
description: Create a screen inside an existing exact screen group; on_conflict must be fail and existing screens are not overwritten.

width.description: Optional positive screen width in pixels.

height.description: Optional positive screen height in pixels.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.
